subject: Mid-quarter alignment: rebench targets & dependency clearance
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ken Owens <ken.owens@brighthealth.com>, Emily Park <emily@qbrfacilitators.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter alignment: rebench targets & dependency clearance

Team —

Quick mid-quarter note ahead of QBR prep. I reviewed the OKR board and did a lightweight rebench based on May/June velocity. High-level: we’re tracking well on platform latency reductions but behind on two product KRs that are now at risk unless key infra work and integrations land by end of August.

Top asks (actionable & timeboxed):
- Infra: KV-cache sharding (owner: vivek_kulkarni) — needs final perf rollout by 8/20 to keep KR #1 (p90 < 120ms). Blockers: a single-node test failure and missing observability hooks. I’ve attached a short dependency matrix.
- Product: Model routing fallbacks (owner: lauren_bishop) — scope must be narrowed to core 3 fallbacks; de-prioritize extensible routing UI for Q3. Decision needed by 7/9.
- CS/Partnerships: BrightHealth integration (external) needs a production auth cert and an SLA addendum; Ken, can you confirm next steps?

Attachments: QBR_slide_draft_v2.pdf (for slides), dependency_matrix.xlsx (live dependency tracker).

Proposed near-term trade: pull the “Extensible routing UI” work out of KR and move it to discovery backlog; reallocate two FE sprints to routing core + infra observability. If we agree, we’ll reflect changes in the QBR slide deck and the OKR tracker.

Please reply with: 1) ack of owners above, 2) any fatal objections to the proposed trade, 3) updated ETA if current dates won’t hold.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
---
Attachments: QBR_slide_draft_v2.pdf (52KB), dependency_matrix.xlsx (24KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter alignment: rebench targets & dependency clearance

Ack — thanks for the summary, Mina.

Quick responses:
- Infra (KV-cache sharding): I own final rollout. The single-node test failure is a concurrency edge case in the shard rebalancer; we have a mitigation but it will take two more backend sprints to harden (ETA 2026-08-22). I’m updating tracing/metrics this week (observability hooks) so we can validate p90 behavior in pre-prod.
- Trade: I support narrowing the product scope to core fallbacks. That gives us runway to complete the sharding work without risking latency KR.

Action items I’m assigning now:
1) Add a short tech note to dependency_matrix.xlsx explaining the test gap and the rollback plan (will do by EOD 7/2).
2) Requesting one additional E-level on-call for the rollout week (8/15–8/21). Can we confirm headcount or temporary budget?

No fatal objections on my end, but if we can’t get the extra E-level we should push the public rollout to 8/30.

-Vivek
VP, Infrastructure Engineering
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 12:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter alignment: rebench targets & dependency clearance

Mina / Vivek —

I agree with the scope pull for the routing UI; we can make the fallback behavior robust without the UI polish. Two notes from product/resource side:

- Engineering capacity: the FE team has two planned sprints (7/12–7/26) already committed to marketplace bug debt and onboarding flows. If we reallocate those sprints we’ll need to shift one merchant onboarding milestone (which impacts a small EU customer ramp). I attached a short capacity plan.
- Timeline trade: moving rollout to 8/30 is reasonable if we cannot secure the extra E-level for the week of 8/15. If we commit to the 8/22 path, we need a hard freeze on any non-critical infra changes the week prior.

Marissa: can you flag the merchant onboarding stakeholders and prepare a comms note if we shift the milestone?

Thanks —
Lauren
Head of Product Management
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: capacity_plan.csv (6KB)

Thanks all — good alignment. Short outcomes to capture here:

1) Decision: Pull extensible routing UI from Q3 KR; focus on core 3 fallbacks. (Owner: lauren_bishop).
2) Infra runway: Vivek to aim for 2026-08-22 rollout; fallback public rollout 2026-08-30 if we cannot secure extra E-level.
3) Communications: Marissa to draft a stakeholder note for merchant onboarding (due 7/6).
4) External: Ken — can BrightHealth confirm whether the integration cert timeline can be expedited? If you need anything from our side (SAML metadata, test certs) call out items here and Emily will coordinate QBR logistics.

I’ll update the OKR board and QBR slide deck this evening and send a revision before close of day. If any owner sees a blocker to the outcomes above, flag it ASAP and we’ll reconvene.

Mina
Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference
